MON_not_right_continuity.argument: Coordinatewise comparability implies equal x, so MON holds. The source-risk image is compact and target minimum is attained. d_R(x,y)=abs(x-y). For every t>0 choose y=1/2 and x=1/2+min(t/2,1/4): d_R<=t yet target-risk gap=1. Thus omega_upper(0)=0 and omega_upper(t)=1 for every positive t.
MON_not_right_continuity.common_loss_realization: Three atoms with losses x,1-x,1{x != 1/2}; source and target distributions are the respective point masses. All losses are in [0,1].
MON_not_right_continuity.hypotheses: F=[0,1]; source risks R(x)=(x,1-x); target risk 1{x != 1/2}
MON_not_right_continuity.source_support: Definition 4 p.4; surrounding consistency claims p.6 lines71-73 and p.7 lines58-59. Does not refute Theorem 2 inequality.

tail_integral_repair.argument: Split min(1,6 exp(-v^2/2)) at a=sqrt(2log6); Gaussian tail <=exp(-a^2/2)/a. Integral <=a+1/a. Adding 1/n is <=(1+a+1/a)/sqrt(n)<4/sqrt(n) for n>=1.
tail_integral_repair.status: supports repair of local constant argument, not proof of full separation theorem
